purpose: Immutable build-provenance record: the OCI reference image used for the Linux frozen-install proof, the pinned tool revisions installed inside it, and every GitHub Actions `uses:` reference resolved to a full commit SHA. Digests were resolved on 2026-09-12 via `docker buildx imagetools inspect` (OCI) and `git ls-remote` (actions); they are immutable revision records, not floating tags.

oci_images.source: https://hub.docker.com/_/python (docker-library official image, Debian trixie-slim base)
oci_images.license: Image contents under Debian/PSF licenses; see https://github.com/docker-library/python
oci_images.notes: Provides the exact .python-version interpreter (3.13.15) as system python; proves the uv.lock requires-python pin without a managed-interpreter download.

tool_installs.integrity_check: SHA-256 compared against https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/SHASUMS256.txt at proof time
SHA-256 compared against the release's SHASUMS256.txt at proof time
pip verifies the wheel against the PyPI-published sha256 fragment
tool_installs.pin_file: config/test-toolchain.json (recorded minimum; uv >=0.12 required for the 3.13.15 managed-interpreter index)

github_actions.note: Pinned in-file by coordinator at T02 integration per proposal P1 and independent review F2; SHA verified via git ls-remote (v4 == v4.4.0).
